id: Hello, \PN!\nI can see you calling me over there!
en: Hello, \PN!\nI can see you calling me over there!
it: Ciao, \PN!\nTi vedo che mi chiami da laggiù!

id: Come over and talk to me.
en: Come over and talk to me.

id: Hello, this is Professor Oak...\nOh, hello, \PN!
en: Hello, this is Professor Oak...\nOh, hello, \PN!

id: So, how's your Pokédex coming along?
en: So, how's your Pokédex coming along?
it: Allora, come procede il tuo Pokédex?

id:
Hmm, let's see..
You've seen \v[1] Pokémon, and 
you've caught \v[2] Pokémon!
I see!
en:
Hmm, let's see..
You've seen \v[1] Pokémon, and 
you've caught \v[2] Pokémon!
I see!
it:
Mmh, vediamo...
Hai visto \v[1] Pokémon e 
ne hai catturati \v[2]!
Capisco!

id: Hmm, you still have a long journey ahead of you! \nKeep on going!
en: Hmm, you still have a long journey ahead of you! \nKeep on going!
it: Mmh, hai ancora un lungo viaggio davanti a te! \nContinua così!

id: Hmm, you're catching Pokémon at a decent pace!
en: Hmm, you're catching Pokémon at a decent pace!
it: Mmh, stai catturando Pokémon a un buon ritmo!

id: You've caught a lot of Pokémon, but make sure you're raising them carefully!
en: You've caught a lot of Pokémon, but make sure you're raising them carefully!
it: Hai catturato tanti Pokémon, ma assicurati di allevarli con cura!

id: I didn't even know that many Pokémon existed!
en: I didn't even know that many Pokémon existed!
it: Non sapevo nemmeno che esistessero così tanti Pokémon!

id: Show me your Pokédex again anytime!
en: Show me your Pokédex again anytime!
it: Mostrami di nuovo il tuo Pokédex quando vuoi!

id: Show me your Pokédex anytime!
en: Show me your Pokédex anytime!
it: Mostrami il tuo Pokédex quando vuoi!

id: \bDo you want me to stop following you?
en: \bDo you want me to stop following you?
it: \bVuoi che smetta di seguirti?

id: \bI'll stay here, then.
en: \bI'll stay here, then.
it: \bAllora resterò qui.

id: \bLet's keep going!
en: \bLet's keep going!
it: \bAndiamo avanti!

id: \bPaul: I can't believe how weak it was. I'm getting rid of it now.
en: \bPaul: I can't believe how weak it was. I'm getting rid of it now.
it: \bPaul: Non posso credere che fosse così debole. Me ne libero subito.

id: \bPaul: What a worthless prize. You can take it. I have no need for it.
en: \bPaul: What a worthless prize. You can take it. I have no need for it.
it: \bPaul: Che premio inutile. Prendilo pure tu. A me non serve.

id: \bCilan: That was wonderful. We should do it again sometime.
en: \bCilan: That was wonderful. We should do it again sometime.
it: \bSpighetto: È stato meraviglioso. Dovremmo rifarlo, prima o poi.

id: Melo...
en: Melo...

id: Cosmog...

it: Cosmog...

id: Rotom Dex: Nebby was taken! After him!

id: \bKiawe: That was great.
